# `factory/gates.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Pipeline orchestration and checks](../../subsystems/pipeline-orchestration-and-checks.md) › `gates.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Runs shell commands (gates) against repositories to verify they pass checks like tests, linting, and coverage, collecting results. No model invocation; gates are facts—exit codes and parsed metrics from deterministic command execution.

1,986 lines, in Pipeline orchestration and checks.

## Parts

Too big to be one node, so shown in 4 parts: groups of its functions that call each other more than the rest of the file.

| Part | Lines | Functions | Largest | Calls out · in |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|
| **Placing and tracking test probes** — Places and runs test probes across a repository's files, reading JUnit output and sweeping report files to determine which files were actually exercised. Functions like probe_placement, run_per_file, and read_junit run the probes, while record_evidence and sweep_reports collect proof of where each probe landed. | 681 | 11 | `probe_placement` | 2 · 6 |
| **Running a gate and reading its results** — Runs a single gate command (via run_gate and run_setup) and parses its output format -- coverage, mutation, or SARIF reports -- to compute a pass/fail result. coverage_total and _exit_still_counts refine this into the final verdict for the gate. | 414 | 8 | `run_gate` | 4 · 1 |
| **Setting up the test session environment** — Prepares the environment a gate runs in: test_session and service_env configure env vars, start_service and _await_ready bring up dependent services, and free_port/_free_space_mb/disk_full_problem check the host has room and ports to run in before execute runs the command. | 414 | 9 | `test_session` | 1 · 1 |
| **Running gates as a probe** — Drives probe_testing and run_gates to execute gates as exploratory probes rather than final checks, using LocalRunner to run them and probe_empty_selection to handle the case where no files were selected to probe. | 267 | 4 | `probe_testing` | 3 · 2 |
